name: Restful Bedroll
body:
Price 3,000 gp; Aura faint transmutation; CL 3; Weight 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This looks like a utilitarian, if well-made, bedroll.

When used the bedroll grants the benefits of 8 hours of sleep in 1 hour. This includes removal of fatigue or exhaustion, natural healing, and spell recovery or preparation. However, any spells or spell-like abilities used within 8 hours of the end of the rest are still counted as used.

Once the special ability of the bedroll is used, it cannot be used, except as a mundane bedroll, for 48 hours.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells sleep
